name: Levenberg-Marquardt Sparse Variant
definition: A sparse variant of the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm implemented to minimize reprojection error between observed and predicted image points, producing optimal estimates for 3D structure and viewing parameters.
summary: The Levenberg-Marquardt Sparse Variant minimizes reprojection error by exploiting Jacobian sparsity to reduce computational complexity, making it efficient when features significantly exceed images.
